The farm

Living land.
Honest food.

Pula Nala — meaning good rain in Setswana — is a family-owned working farm set in the peaceful outskirts of Pretoria. Nine hectares of seasonal produce, open air, and unhurried calm.

Day visits are open to individuals, couples, and families who want to slow down, connect with the land, and eat food that comes straight from the earth.

Family-owned 9 hectares Seasonal produce Day visits

What's on offer

Choose your Pula Nala day.

Three signature experiences shaped by the land and the season.

01
Family Forage Challenge

Walk the land, follow the clues, gather your ingredients, build the fire, cook your potjie, share the table. Limited to 15 families.

R1,100 per family · up to 5 members
02
Grounded Seasonal Dining

An intimate table celebrating what the earth produces right now. No printed menu. Seats no more than sixteen guests.

Contact us for upcoming dates
03
Farm Day Visit

Wander the land, breathe open air, eat food from the earth. A quiet, unhurried day for individuals, couples, and families.

R500 per person · full day

From the earth

"Abundance feeds many."

Everything at Pula Nala grows from this soil. Pulled from the ground, brought to the table — the cycle of good food is as honest as it gets.

Come and see where your food comes from. Walk the land. Get your hands dirty. Leave full.
